html:
G'oya

Ikki shart: sotuvchining mahsuloti bor va uning mahsulotlaridan birortasi ham order_items da uchramaydi. Ikkalasi ham "shunday qator bormi" degan savol, ya'ni EXISTS va NOT EXISTS.

Yechim

SELECT s.id, s.name
FROM sellers s
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.seller_id = s.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM products p
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    WHERE p.seller_id = s.id
  )

Birinchi shartsiz Dilnoza ham chiqadi: uning mahsuloti yo'q, demak sotilgani ham yo'q.

Tuzoqlar

NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items) bu masalada natijani butunlay bo'sh qiladi. order_items da NULL bor, p.id NOT IN (1, 3, NULL) esa hech qachon rost bo'lmaydi: p.id <> NULL noma'lum.

Noto'g'riSELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.name
FROM sellers s
JOIN products p ON p.seller_id = s.id
WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)

Bu so'rovda ikkinchi xato ham bor: u sotilmagan mahsuloti bor sotuvchini qidiradi. Aziz quvvatlagichni sotmagan, lekin g'ilofi sotilgan. U ro'yxatga tushmasligi kerak.

Boshqa yo'l

Guruhlash bilan: sotuvchini mahsulotlariga JOIN, savdolarga LEFT JOIN qilib, savdo qatorlari sonini sanaymiz. COUNT(oi.id) NULL larni sanamaydi, shuning uchun savdosiz sotuvchida u 0:

SELECT s.id, s.name
FROM sellers s
JOIN products p ON p.seller_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
HAVING COUNT(oi.id) = 0
